requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: I was the principal developer on the signal chain: chirp de-ramping, 2D-FFT processing, CFAR detection, and the Doppler ambiguity resolver.

requirements.note: This describes FMCW radar range-Doppler signal processing for a single automotive corner-radar module, not phased-array or multi-element beamforming work; not treated as evidence for that specific requirement per the refuse-to-guess rule.

lines.quote: Embedded DSP: 15+ years developing real-time signal processing firmware in C and C++ on TI C6000 and Xilinx Zynq platforms; most recently a wideband channeliser on ZynqMP RFSoC for a naval intercept receiver.

Production Python: built and maintain the internal calibration data management system (~12,000 lines), handling instrument logs, measurement databases, and automated nightly regression tests; in production since 2019.

Responsible for RF front-end test and characterisation on the company's naval surveillance receiver programme: conducted noise figure, gain flatness, and third-order intercept measurements across the 2–18 GHz band using Rohde & Schwarz FSW spectrum analysers and ZVA vector network analysers.

Part of the integration team for the SIGINT payload on the Norrland Skywatch AEW&C platform (2015–2019), handling signal conditioning chain testing and pre-deployment verification at the Gothenburg integration facility.
Signal conditioning and data acquisition architecture review for an infrared spectrometer payload proposed for the EORA EXOLENS exoplanet mission.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience

lines.quote: Contributed to the MSc-level thesis project "Wideband Noise Analysis in Multi-Channel Receivers" (2018) as industry supervisor, providing test data sets and measurement protocols.

requirements.note: This describes acting as an external industry supervisor for a university thesis, not formal leadership of an internal team; treated conservatively as not_stated rather than inferred as team-lead experience.

lines.quote: All deliverables written in English for the multinational consortium.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal processing, if any?
